tests.title: A poll cycle turns a person's comment plus a re-added af:fix into an answer to the blocked fix job
given: workspace widgets subscribed with prefix af:, real store and jobs layer, fakerunner, fakeclock, fake hub
fix job J for issue 42 is blocked on attempt 1; its question comment (marker kind=question) is on the issue
a person (login alice) comments 'use the greeting from the README' after the question and adds af:fix
tests.when: one Supervisor.Cycle runs
then: J has attempt 2 with trigger {kind: answer, by: 'label af:fix'}
attempt 2 answer.question is the blocked question, option is null, and text contains the comment and 'alice'
af:fix is removed from issue 42 through hub
no new job exists
tests.pseudocode: env.blockFix(42); env.hub.AddPersonComment(42,'alice','use the greeting from the README'); env.hub.AddLabel(42,'af:fix'); env.cycle(); d=jobs.Get(J); assert d.attempts[1].trigger=={answer,'label af:fix'}; assert contains(d.attempts[1].answer.text,'alice'); assert !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: The runner of an attempt queued by a forge answer receives the answer among Answers
given: the setup of an answered blocked fix job with fakerunner recording RunRequest
tests.when: attempt 2 starts after the poll answer
then: RunRequest.Answers contains the question and the text with the comment and its author
tests.pseudocode: req=fakerunner.Requests()[last]; assert any(a.Question==q && contains(a.Text,'use the greeting') for a in req.Answers)

tests.title: The event stream answers a blocked job with by set to the hub event id
given: blocked fix job J for issue 42 with its question comment
a person comment after the question
stream event evt-7 hub.forge.issue.labeled af:fix for issue 42
tests.when: the stream handles evt-7, reading the issue through hub
then: attempt 2 has trigger {kind: answer, by: evt-7}
the answer text holds the comment and its author
af:fix is removed
tests.pseudocode: stream.Handle(event('evt-7','af:fix',42)); assert d.attempts[1].trigger=={answer,'evt-7'}

tests.title: The sighting rules apply in the fixed order and each outcome is logged at INFO
given: a table of states on issue 42 for the poll and for the stream: pending follow-up + open blocked fix job, blocked job + owed removal, held label, owed record, newer record + failed latest job, failed latest job, no job
tests.when: a fix-label sighting is handled for each row
then: a pending follow-up decides before an open job
an open blocked job (no owed, no newer) decides before hold, owed, newer, retry and new request
hold beats owed, owed beats newer record, newer record beats retry, retry beats new request
the poll and the stream give the same decision for every row
answered, retried, no answer found and follow-up made each log one INFO line naming workspace, kind, issue, label and job
tests.pseudocode: for row in table: assert decide_poll(row)==decide_stream(row)==row.expected; assert log.find('INFO', row.outcome) has fields ws,kind,issue,label,job

tests.title: A record newer than the listing makes the sighting do nothing and leaves the label
given: a poll record of af:fix on issue 42 made at or after the listing's Requested time
a blocked job, a failed job and a no-job case are each tried
tests.when: the poll sees af:fix on issue 42 for each case
then: no attempt and no job is made
no comment is posted
af:fix is still on the issue
the job's attempt count and the issue's comments are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: insertRecord(42,'af:fix',at=listing.Requested+0); cycle(); assert attempts==before; assert comments==before; assert hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: A label on an issue whose open job is queued, running or blocked with an owed removal is absorbed
given: an open fix job for issue 42 in state queued, running, and blocked-with-owed-removal in turn
tests.when: the poll sees af:fix on issue 42
then: no attempt or job is made
af:fix is removed
tests.pseudocode: for st in [queued,running,blockedOwed]: setup(st); cycle(); assert attempts==before && jobs==before; assert !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: A re-added af:fix on a failed fix job retries the same job with the comments as context
given: the latest fix job of issue 42 failed on attempt n and its failure comment is on the issue
a person comments 'the log is in CI run 812' after it and adds af:fix
tests.when: one poll cycle runs
then: the same job has attempt n+1 with trigger {kind: retry, by: 'label af:fix'}
no new job is made
the attempt's context holds the comment text with its author
af:fix is removed
tests.pseudocode: cycle(); d=Get(J); assert len(d.attempts)==n+1; assert d.attempts[n].trigger=={retry,'label af:fix'}; assert contains(d.attempts[n].context[0],'CI run 812'); assert count(jobs)==1

tests.title: A forge retry with no comments since the failure runs with no added context and posts no reply
given: a failed fix job of issue 42 and no person comment after the failure comment
af:fix is added
tests.when: one poll cycle runs
then: attempt n+1 exists with trigger retry
its context is null
no reply comment is posted
tests.pseudocode: cycle(); assert d.attempts[n].context==nil; assert comments==before

tests.title: A label on an issue whose latest job is done or cancelled, or that has none, makes a new job and leaves the old one untouched
given: issue 42 whose latest triage job is done, and another case whose latest fix job is cancelled
a person edits the issue's original report and adds af:triage
tests.when: one poll cycle runs
then: a new job exists with source {kind: label, by: 'label af:triage'} (or event / label af:fix for the cancelled fix)
the earlier job's document is byte-for-byte unchanged
no retry and no answer is made
tests.pseudocode: before=json(Get(T0)); cycle(); assert Get(T0)==before; assert newJob.source=={label,'label af:triage'}

tests.title: Answers, retries and replies write a record before the removal and name the job only when its request_label is the label
given: a hub that fails the first removal of af:fix
jobs with request_label af:fix and with no request_label (API-made)
tests.when: an answer, a retry, a no_answer reply and a thread_cut reply are each consumed
then: a record of af:fix on 42 exists before the removal is attempted
the removal is owed while it fails and the next cycle retries it
the record names the job when job.request_label == af:fix, otherwise no job
tests.pseudocode: hub.FailRemove(1); cycle(); r=records.Find(42,'af:fix'); assert r.Owed; assert (r.JobID==J)==(job.RequestLabel=='af:fix')

tests.title: A repeated sighting of the same label adds no attempt and posts no comment
given: a blocked or failed job with or without request_label, and a fakerunner that ends the new attempt blocked or failed at once
tests.when: for any sequence of sightings of one label from {stream event, poll cycle, stale poll listing requested before the first outcome}, in any order, after the first outcome
then: exactly one attempt follows the first sighting
no second reply comment is posted
the record survives drop until every listing requested before it has been handled
tests.pseudocode: for seq in permutations(sightings): setup(); apply(seq); assert attempts==base+1; assert replyCount<=1

tests.title: An API answer landing between the poll's read and its answer makes the poll absorb the label
given: blocked job J, a person comment and af:fix
a hook that answers J through the API after the poll's issue read
tests.when: the poll cycle reaches its answer step
then: the jobs layer gives a state refusal
exactly one attempt n+1 exists
af:fix is removed
no comment is posted
tests.pseudocode: hook.afterRead(()=>svc.Answer(J,'api',{Answer:'x'})); cycle(); assert len(attempts)==2; assert !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix'); assert comments==before

tests.title: An answer for an unsubscribed workspace writes nothing to the issue and ends the cycle
given: a Jobs fake whose Answer returns ErrNotSubscribed
tests.when: the answer sighting is handled
then: no comment and no label change on the issue
no attempt
the cycle ends without handling later issues
tests.pseudocode: jobs.answerErr=ErrNotSubscribed; cycle(); assert hub.writes==0; assert !later.handled

tests.title: An unreadable token or other jobs-layer error on answer leaves the label and logs one failure row
given: a Jobs fake whose Answer fails with a token error, then with a generic error
tests.when: the answer sighting is handled twice in two cycles
then: af:fix stays on the issue
no attempt is made
one failure row is logged per (row, op)
tests.pseudocode: for e in [tokenErr, genericErr]: jobs.answerErr=e; cycle(); assert hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix'); assert attempts==before; assert log.count(row)==1

tests.title: Comments are read through the issue read and never through the comment list
given: a fake hub counting requests per route
a stream sighting that already made an issue read
tests.when: a poll answer sighting and a stream answer sighting are handled
then: GET …/issues/{n} is called
GET …/issues/{n}/comments is not called by the sighting rules
the stream reuses its own issue read (one read per sighting)
tests.pseudocode: cycle(); stream.Handle(ev); assert hub.calls['GET issues/42']>=1; assert hub.calls['GET issues/42/comments']==0

tests.title: Counted comments follow the anchor marker, or the finish time when no comment carries it
given: comments: before-question, question marker for job J attempt 2, two later person comments
a second thread where no comment has the marker and attempts[2].finished_at is T, with comments before, at, and after T
a thread with an older attempt's marker only
tests.when: the answer comments are computed
then: only comments after the latest attempt's marker comment count, in list order
without the marker only comments with created_at at or after T count (T inclusive)
an older attempt's marker is not an anchor
tests.pseudocode: assert texts(counted(thread1,J,2))==['c2','c3']; assert texts(counted(thread2,J,2,T))==['at','after']

tests.title: Comments before the question, marker-carrying comments anywhere and blank comments are left out
given: a thread with a comment before the question, a person comment containing '<!-- agent-fox' in the middle of text, a comment of only whitespace, and one valid comment after the question
tests.when: the answer comments are computed
then: only the valid comment counts
a comment carrying the marker later in its body is dropped
a whitespace-only comment is dropped
tests.pseudocode: assert len(counted(thread))==1 && counted[0].body=='valid'

tests.title: Rendered comment text is valid UTF-8 with no NUL, in issue order
given: any list of counted comments with arbitrary bytes in bodies and logins
tests.when: for any non-empty list of comments the text is rendered
then: the text contains no NUL byte and is valid UTF-8
each block is '--- comment by <login> ---' followed by the trimmed body
blocks are joined by a blank line in the order of the list
tests.pseudocode: for cs in gen(): t=render(cs); assert !contains(t,'\x00'); assert utf8.Valid(t); assert order(blocks(t))==order(cs)

tests.title: A text over 8192 bytes is cut at a UTF-8 boundary to at most 8192 bytes with the cut line last
given: generated texts of multi-byte runes around the 8192-byte limit
tests.when: for any rendered text of any length the bound is applied
then: a text of at most 8192 bytes is unchanged
a longer text ends with the line '[… cut at 8192 bytes; the issue holds the rest …]'
the result is valid UTF-8 and at most 8192 bytes, cut line included
tests.pseudocode: for t in gen(): r=bound(t); if len(t)<=8192: assert r==t else: assert endsWith(lastLine(r),CUT) && len(r)<=8192 && utf8.Valid(r)

tests.title: When hub fails the issue read, the label stays, nothing happens, and the next cycle goes ahead
given: blocked fix job J with a person comment and af:fix
hub answers 503 to the issue read; a variant answers 401 or 403
tests.when: one cycle runs, hub recovers, and a second cycle runs
then: in the first cycle no attempt, no comment, af:fix still on the issue, one WARN logged, the cycle ends
in the second cycle attempt 2 is queued
tests.pseudocode: hub.Fail(issueRead,503); cycle(); assert attempts==1 && hasLabel && log.find('WARN')==1; hub.Heal(); cycle(); assert attempts==2

tests.title: A 4xx on one issue's read or comments_err reports the failure and the cycle goes on to the next issue
given: issues 42 and 43 each with a blocked fix job and af:fix
hub answers issue 42's read with 404 (variant: comments_err set)
tests.when: one cycle runs
then: issue 42 keeps af:fix, no attempt and no comment
the failure is reported
issue 43 is answered in the same cycle
tests.pseudocode: hub.Fail(read42,404); cycle(); assert hasLabel(42) && attempts(J42)==1 && comments42==before; assert attempts(J43)==2

tests.title: The stream takes no action on a sighting whose comments it cannot read
given: a blocked fix job with a person comment
hub fails the stream's issue read, or answers comments_err
tests.when: the stream handles the label event
then: no attempt, no comment and no label change
the poll's later cycle then answers the job
tests.pseudocode: hub.Fail(issueRead); stream.Handle(ev); assert attempts==1 && comments==before && hasLabel; hub.Heal(); cycle(); assert attempts==2

tests.title: The attempt document shows context as a list of strings or null
given: a job with a forge retry carrying context and an attempt with none
tests.when: the job document is read
then: the retry attempt shows context as a list holding the comment text
attempts without context show context null
tests.pseudocode: d=Get(J); assert d.attempts[1].context==[text]; assert d.attempts[0].context==nil

tests.title: The runner's Context is the job context followed by each attempt's context in order, kept by an automatic attempt
given: a job created with context ['job ctx'], a forge retry with text 'R1', then an automatic attempt after it
tests.when: RunRequest is built for the automatic attempt and the worker builds its --context values
then: RunRequest.Context == ['job ctx','R1'] ending with the forge comment text
the worker passes each as a --context value with no question
tests.pseudocode: req=store.RunRequest(J,3); assert req.Context==['job ctx','R1']; args=loopArgs(req); assert count(args,'--context=')>=2

tests.title: The API retry stays body-less and queues an attempt with null context
given: a failed job
tests.when: POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry is called with no body, and again with a body
then: the body-less call returns success and the new attempt has context null
a call with a body is refused as before
tests.pseudocode: r=post(retry,nil); assert ok; assert Get(J).attempts[n].context==nil; assert post(retry,{x:1}).status==400

tests.title: A duplicate or state refusal on retry absorbs the label
given: failed job J; a hook that retries J through the API after the poll's read; another case where another open job took the issue
tests.when: the poll's retry step is refused
then: no extra attempt or job exists
af:fix is removed
tests.pseudocode: hook.afterRead(()=>svc.Retry(J,'api')); cycle(); assert attempts==n+1; assert !hasLabel(42)

tests.title: A retry that fails with ErrNotSubscribed, a token error or another error behaves as an answer does
given: a Jobs fake whose Retry returns ErrNotSubscribed, a token error, and a generic error in turn
tests.when: the retry sighting is handled
then: ErrNotSubscribed: nothing written to the issue and the cycle ends
other errors: failure reported, af:fix stays
no attempt and no comment in all three
tests.pseudocode: for e in errs: jobs.retryErr=e; cycle(); assert noAttempt && comments==before; assert hasLabel== (e!=ErrNotSubscribed)

tests.title: No answer found posts one reply, removes the label, and a repeat posts no second reply
given: blocked fix job J on attempt n with its question comment and no comment after it
tests.when: af:fix is added, a cycle runs, af:fix is added again with still no comment, and a second cycle runs
then: no attempt is made
one reply comment 'No answer found since the question; comment, then add the label `af:fix` again.' ending with '<!-- agent-fox job=J attempt=n kind=no_answer -->'
af:fix is removed both times
the comment count is unchanged by the second cycle
tests.pseudocode: cycle(); assert comments==c0+1 && contains(last,'kind=no_answer'); readd(); cycle(); assert comments==c0+1 && !hasLabel && attempts==n

tests.title: A cut thread on an answer sighting posts the thread_cut reply, warns once and makes no attempt
given: blocked fix job J and a person comment after the question
hub answers issue 42's read with truncated: true through Inject
tests.when: af:fix is added and one cycle runs
then: no attempt is made and af:fix is removed
one WARN naming workspace, issue 42 and J
one reply that says the whole thread could not be read, names 'af jobs answer J' and 'POST /api/v1/jobs/J/answer' and ends with '<!-- agent-fox job=J attempt=n kind=thread_cut -->'
tests.pseudocode: hub.Inject(read42,{truncated:true,...}); cycle(); assert attempts==n && !hasLabel; assert log.count('WARN')==1; assert contains(last,'af jobs answer '+J)

tests.title: A cut thread on a retry sighting makes no retry and names af jobs retry and the retry route
given: failed fix job J with a failure comment
hub answers the issue read with truncated: true
tests.when: af:fix is added and one cycle runs
then: J stays failed with no new attempt
one WARN is logged
one reply names 'af jobs retry J' and 'POST /api/v1/jobs/J/retry' with the thread_cut marker
af:fix is removed
tests.pseudocode: cycle(); assert d.state=='failed' && len(d.attempts)==n; assert contains(last,'POST /api/v1/jobs/'+J+'/retry'); assert !hasLabel

tests.title: A reply that cannot be posted logs a WARN and the label is removed all the same
given: hub fails comment POST with 503
a no-answer case and a cut-thread case
tests.when: one cycle runs for each case
then: one WARN is logged per case
af:fix is removed
no attempt is made
tests.pseudocode: hub.Fail(postComment,503); cycle(); assert !hasLabel && attempts==n && log.find('WARN')>=1

tests.title: The question comment names the forge path and keeps the old instructions
given: a worker harness with fake hub, a blocked fix job on issue 42, prefix af:, AF_POLL_INTERVAL unset
tests.when: the worker posts the question comment
then: it contains 'Or reply on this issue, then add the label `af:fix` again: agent-fox takes the comments after this one as the answer.'
it still contains 'af jobs answer' and 'POST'…'/answer'
tests.pseudocode: c=question_comment(); assert contains(c,NEW) && contains(c,'af jobs answer') && contains(c,'/answer')

tests.title: The failure comment and the parked fix summary name the forge path and keep their instructions
given: a failed attempt comment for a fix job and for a triage job, and a parked fix's fix_summary
tests.when: the worker composes them with the label triggers on
then: each contains 'Or add the label `<prefix><kind>` again; comments after this one go with the new attempt.' with the job's kind
the failure comment still names 'POST …/retry'
the parked summary still names 'af jobs retry' and 'POST …/retry'
tests.pseudocode: for c in [failure(fix),failure(triage),parkedSummary]: assert contains(c,sentence(kind)); assert contains(parked,'af jobs retry')

tests.title: With AF_POLL_INTERVAL=0 none of the three comments carries the forge-path sentence
given: an attempt whose hub variable AF_POLL_INTERVAL is '0s'
tests.when: the question, failure and parked fix summary comments are composed
then: none contains the forge-path sentence
the existing instructions remain in each
tests.pseudocode: vars={'AF_POLL_INTERVAL':'0s'}; for c in comments: assert !contains(c,'add the label') && contains(c,oldInstruction)

tests.title: The worker reads AF_POLL_INTERVAL with the poll's values and never fails on it
given: values: unset, empty, '0', '0s', '30s', '5m', '1h', 'banana', '-1m', '48h'
tests.when: the worker's settings resolve for a triage and for a fix
then: unset, empty and every non-zero or invalid value mean triggers on
'0' and '0s' mean off
no value produces a config failure
tests.pseudocode: for v,on in table: s,err=resolveSettings(kind,vars(v)); assert err==nil; assert s.TriggersOn==on

tests.title: AF_AUTO_FIX is read for triage only and accepts empty, true and false in any case
given: values '', 'true', 'TRUE', 'True', 'false', 'FALSE'
tests.when: resolveSettings runs for a triage and for a fix
then: empty and false resolve to false; true in any case resolves to true for a triage
a fix attempt does not read it, even with 'maybe'
tests.pseudocode: for v,w in table: s,_=resolveSettings(triage,{AF_AUTO_FIX:v}); assert s.AutoFix==w; _,err=resolveSettings(fix,{AF_AUTO_FIX:'maybe'}); assert err==nil

tests.title: AF_AUTO_FIX=maybe fails a triage as a non-retryable config envelope naming the variable
given: a triage attempt with AF_AUTO_FIX=maybe
tests.when: the worker runs the attempt
then: the envelope is failed with category config, not retryable
fix_hint.var is AF_AUTO_FIX
tests.pseudocode: env=run(triage,{AF_AUTO_FIX:'maybe'}); assert env.status=='failed' && env.error.category=='config' && !env.error.retryable && env.error.fix_hint.var=='AF_AUTO_FIX'

tests.title: A confirmed triage with AF_AUTO_FIX=true records a pending follow-up and adds af:fix
given: worker harness, fake hub, real jobs layer
triage of issue 42 ends confirmed, AF_AUTO_FIX=true; a text triage case that created an issue
tests.when: the worker runs the mirror
then: the follow-up is recorded before the label is written
the triage job document shows follow_up {label: af:fix, issue: 42, state: pending, job_id: null}
af:fix is in labels.set and side_effects (add_labels)
a text/file triage's follow-up names the created issue
tests.pseudocode: run(); d=Get(T); assert d.follow_up=={af:fix,42,pending,nil}; assert 'af:fix' in env.labels.set; assert order(recordFollowUp)<order(addLabel)

tests.title: An open fix job at ask time makes the follow-up absorbed and the label is not added
given: a queued or blocked fix job J of issue 42
a confirmed triage with AF_AUTO_FIX=true
tests.when: the mirror asks for the follow-up
then: follow_up.state is absorbed with job_id J
af:fix is not added to the issue
tests.pseudocode: run(); assert Get(T).follow_up=={...,absorbed,J}; assert !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: The three skip cases record nothing, add no label and warn auto_fix_skipped with the reason
given: a confirmed triage with AF_AUTO_FIX=true in turn: AF_POLL_INTERVAL=0, a carry_patch workspace, AF_FIX_LAND=patch
also AF_FIX_LAND=bogus on a triage
tests.when: the worker runs the triage
then: envelope warnings include auto_fix_skipped whose message names the reason for each case
follow_up is null and no af:fix side effect
AF_FIX_LAND=bogus does not fail the triage
tests.pseudocode: for case in cases: env=run(case); assert warn(env,'auto_fix_skipped').message contains case.reason; assert Get(T).follow_up==nil; assert !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: A recording failure adds no label; a label write failure withdraws the follow-up; both warn auto_fix_failed
given: a confirmed triage with AF_AUTO_FIX=true
case A: the jobs layer cannot record the follow-up
case B: hub answers 503 to the label write
tests.when: the worker runs the mirror
then: A: no label is added and the envelope carries auto_fix_failed
B: a failed side effect is recorded, follow_up.state is withdrawn and the envelope carries auto_fix_failed
tests.pseudocode: runA(); assert !hasLabel && warn('auto_fix_failed'); runB(); assert Get(T).follow_up.state=='withdrawn' && failedSideEffect('add_labels')

tests.title: No follow-up is asked for with AF_AUTO_FIX unset or false, a suspected triage, or a failed triage
given: triage runs: AF_AUTO_FIX unset, AF_AUTO_FIX=false, confidence suspected with AF_AUTO_FIX=true, not_reproducible, and a failed triage
tests.when: the worker runs each
then: follow_up is null
no af:fix label is added by the worker
tests.pseudocode: for c in cases: run(c); assert Get(T).follow_up==nil && !hub.HasLabel(42,'af:fix')

tests.title: A resumed mirror asks again, keeps one follow-up and adds the label only while pending
given: a triage whose mirror was interrupted after the follow-up was recorded; variants with state pending, made, absorbed, withdrawn
tests.when: the delivery resumes the mirror
then: the triage job still has exactly one follow-up
the label is added again only when the state is pending
tests.pseudocode: for st in states: setState(T,st); resume(); assert countFollowUps(T)==1; assert addLabelCalled==(st=='pending')

tests.title: A later triage's pending follow-up withdraws the earlier pending one and at most one stays pending
given: triage T0 of issue 42 with a pending follow-up
a second recording by the same triage job
tests.when: triage T1 of issue 42 records its follow-up
then: T1's follow-up is pending and T0's is withdrawn
only one pending follow-up exists for the workspace and issue
a repeated record for one triage job leaves one follow-up
tests.pseudocode: rec(T0); rec(T1); assert Get(T1).follow_up.state=='pending' && Get(T0).follow_up.state=='withdrawn'; rec(T1); assert countFollowUps(T1)==1

tests.title: A follow-up stands as recorded whatever becomes of its triage job
given: a pending follow-up of triage T
tests.when: T is cancelled, fails, or is retried, and time passes
then: the follow-up stays pending with the same label, issue and job_id null until a sighting or a later triage changes it
tests.pseudocode: for ev in [cancel,fail,retry]: apply(T,ev); assert Get(T).follow_up.state=='pending'

tests.title: A create request with an invalid parent is refused as invalid and stores nothing
given: a triage job T1 in workspace widgets, a triage job T2 in another workspace, a fix job F
tests.when: Create is called with parent_job_id for: source label; source triage with parent F (not triage); parent T2 (other workspace); source.by T1 but parent T3
then: each returns an invalid-request error
the job count is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for req in bad: err=Create(req); assert errors.Is(err,ErrInvalid); assert count(jobs)==before

tests.title: Every job document carries parent_job_id and follow_up
given: a triage job that asked for a follow-up, a fix job made from it, and an ordinary job
tests.when: the job documents are read
then: triage doc: parent_job_id null and follow_up {label, issue, state, job_id}
fix doc: parent_job_id is the triage id, follow_up null
ordinary job: both null
tests.pseudocode: assert Get(T).follow_up.keys==[label,issue,state,job_id]; assert Get(F).parent_job_id==T; assert Get(X).follow_up==nil

tests.title: The retention purge removes a triage job's follow-up and keeps parent_job_id on the fix job
given: triage T with a follow-up made into fix job F, T older than the retention limit
tests.when: the purge runs
then: T and its follow-up row are gone
F's parent_job_id is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: purge(); assert count(followups where triage=T)==0; assert Get(F).parent_job_id==T

tests.title: A fix job from a follow-up and the follow-up's made state are never seen apart
given: a pending follow-up and a store that can fail at any step of the transaction
tests.when: for any failure injected at any point of making the linked fix job, and for any concurrent reader
then: a reader sees either both the fix job and follow-up made, or neither
a failure partway leaves a pending follow-up and no job
tests.pseudocode: for step in steps: inject(step); try Make(); s=snapshot(); assert (s.job!=nil)==(s.followUp.state=='made')

tests.title: A fix label with a pending follow-up makes one linked fix job and marks the follow-up made
given: issue 42's pending follow-up from triage T, no open fix job, af:fix on the issue
tests.when: the trigger sees af:fix
then: one fix job with source {kind: triage, by: T}, parent_job_id T, request_label af:fix, input {issue: 42}
T's follow_up is {state: made, job_id: <fix job>}
holds of af:fix on 42 end, the poll's record of the job is written, and af:fix is removed
